verdict.rationale: The product's own documented automation is saved tasks that can be invoked through Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and Control Center (gh-2). Those are manual or host-platform invocation paths, not a product-native rule engine. Nothing in the evidence shows the product letting users define event-based rules that trigger actions automatically. Any event triggering would have to come from iOS Shortcuts automations, a host-platform capability that earns no credit.
